title: Credit Builder Accounts Made-Good Relief: Addition for a Recent Returned-Payment Fee
content:
The relief share of the made-good relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the returned-payment fee it relieves, the fee charged for the most recent returned payment, is recent.

## Age of the fee

When the returned-payment fee was charged 15 or fewer calendar days before today (today less the fee's date, so a fee charged today is 0 days old), the prompt addition is added; when 16 to 45 days before, the recent addition; when longer ago, nothing is added for the fee's age.

| Age of the fee | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 15 days | prompt addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| 16 to 45 days | recent addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| 46 days or more | nothing |

## Band edges (hypothetical dates)

A fee dated 10 June is 15 days old on 25 June (prompt), 16 days old on 26 June (recent), 45 days old on 25 July (recent) and 46 days old on 26 July (nothing).
